text:
tablet_yuki: Previous note (nightstand_b1 for late afternoon) is incorrect for early morning. Day 28: kitchen_table_k1 at 07:43. Yuki keeps the tablet at the kitchen table in the early morning (before 9:00), not the bedroom nightstand. Check kitchen_table_k1 for queries before 09:00. The nightstand is for late afternoon/evening.

water_bottle_yuki: Previous note (desk_b1 for afternoon) is inconsistent. Day 28: desk_b1 at 08:25, but sink_k1 at 13:24. Yuki moves the bottle to the kitchen sink during the midday break (around 13:00). Check desk_b1 for morning work hours (08:00-12:00) and sink_k1 for midday (12:00-14:00).

mug_yuki: Previous note (coffee_table_l1 for evening) is incorrect for midday. Day 28: desk_b1 at 08:26, but sink_k1 at 13:25. Like the water bottle, the mug moves to the kitchen sink during the midday break. Check desk_b1 for morning work hours and sink_k1 for midday. Do not assume living room spots until evening.

charger_yuki: New pattern. Day 28: nightstand_b1 at 22:47. Yuki moves the charger to the bedroom nightstand in the late evening, not keeping it at the desk. Check nightstand_b1 for queries after 20:00.

glass_yuki: Previous note (kitchen_table_k1 for evening) is incorrect for late night. Day 28: nightstand_b1 at 22:47. Yuki moves drinking glasses to the bedroom nightstand in the very late evening (after 22:00), not leaving them on the kitchen table. Check nightstand_b1 for queries after 22:00.

General Pattern: Yuki’s items follow a strict daily cycle. Morning: Kitchen table (tablet) or Desk (bottle/mug). Midday (13:00): Kitchen sink (bottle/mug). Late Evening (20:00+): Bedroom nightstand (charger, glass, tablet). Update anchors to reflect this temporal shift, overriding static location assumptions.
